Roster <- read.csv("Math252-S21-roster-clean.csv") %>%
  tidyr::separate(email, into = c("user", "domain"), sep = "@", remove = FALSE) 
WWRoster <- 
  with(Roster, 
       webwork::ww_roster(
         email = email, user = user, id = id, last_name = last,
         first_name = first, comment = id))
write.csv(WWRoster, row.names = FALSE, file = "wwRoster-m252-s21.lst")
